sources.paraphrase: pg_read_binary_file returns bytea and performs no text-encoding checks. Its existing direct postgres use needs no new grant.
sha256(bytea) returns a bytea digest. encode with hex produces lowercase hexadecimal text. octet_length(bytea) reports byte count.

planned_exact_expression: encode(sha256(pg_read_binary_file(current_setting('hba_file'))),'hex') and octet_length over the same binary file value; retain pg_hba_file_rules error absence
